objective: Answer from official Claude Code documentation and changelog the subagent, settings and cloud-session questions listed in the prompt, for Claude Code 2.1.300.
scope: Official Claude Code docs: subagents, settings, plugins reference, Claude Code on the web, changelog
constraints: Cite the URL and the quoted line for each answer; say 'not documented' when the docs are silent rather than inferring.
acceptance_criteria: Each numbered question has an answer with a citation, or 'not documented'.
result: Docs answers: autoCompactWindow subagent-only (100000-1000000, >=2.1.296, no effect on main-thread agent, env CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW overrides); plugin settings agent key supported, cloud behavior not documented; cloud sessions do not read ~/.claude/settings.json, read repo .claude/settings.json only in single-repo sessions, env vars on the environment; setup-script settings.json write not documented; deniedModels managed-only (>=2.1.283), server-managed needs Team/Enterprise; /code-review subagent type/model and deny interaction not documented; claude plugin eval exists (>=2.1.269), real model cost, --max-cost-usd; bin/ on PATH and claude.ai/Cowork refuse plugins with bin/.

acceptance.rationale: Each of the seven questions is answered with a cited docs URL and quoted line or explicitly marked not documented; fetches were real WebFetch calls; limits (summarized fetch, partial changelog) are disclosed.

criteria_evidence.Each numbered question has an answer wit: Q1,3,6,7 answered with citations; Q2,4 partly with citations and the gaps marked not documented; Q5 not documented.

required_evidence.answers: Seven numbered answers in the report.
